title: Fleet messages
summary: Each message is one immutable envelope with separately owned recipient records. A project recipient belongs to its project; a recipient outside any project belongs to its organization, whatever the sender's scope, and mixed fanout carries both. Direct session selectors reach authorized organization sessions; project selectors never add them. Wake, receipts, history and read visibility use the recipient's own scope policy and never reveal hidden recipients. These are source behaviors; deployed proof is pending. A single-message read exposes state only for the caller's session or actor receipt. Without a receipt, requesting state refuses with message_field_unknown and lists recipients among the accepted fields; read recipients for recipient states. Field-projected output adds no absent identity or body fields.
